plan.reason: With only 24 of 100 evaluations and full stagnation, the surrogate is still data-scarce in 10-D; auto lets held-out RMSE pick between RBF and ridge-quadratic rather than committing prematurely. current_to_best balances convergence with diversity at this early stage, and mildly raised exploration (0.35) with a slightly larger radius (0.15) encourages sampling under-covered regions since nearest-distance novelty is the only uncertainty proxy available. A moderate population (36) and few generations (5) per cycle keep true-evaluation spend efficient given the fixed budget, while local_fraction 0.25 retains some intensification around the best-so-far point.

At 44/100 evaluations in 10-D with high surrogate RMSE (0.73), the model is still data-scarce, so auto is preferred to let held-out RMSE choose RBF vs quadratic rather than committing. There is recent improvement (0.22) but also stagnation, so keeping current_to_best preserves convergence while raised exploration (0.45) and slightly larger radius (0.18) push sampling toward under-covered regions via the nearest-distance novelty proxy. Population 36 and generations 5 keep surrogate overhead modest against the fixed true-evaluation budget, and local_fraction 0.3 retains moderate intensification.

At 64/100 evaluations in 10-D, remaining budget is tight (36 evaluations). Normalized RMSE 0.235 is moderate, so auto lets held-out RMSE pick RBF vs quadratic rather than committing. Recent relative improvement is 0.0 with stagnation 10, indicating convergence stalls; raising exploration to 0.6 and radius to 0.20 steers acquisition toward under-covered regions via the novelty proxy while current_to_best balances convergence and diversity. Population 36 and generations 5 keep surrogate overhead small relative to the fixed true-evaluation budget, and local_fraction 0.3 retains moderate intensification.

Only 16 true evaluations remain, so surrogate overhead must stay minimal: population 28 and generations 4 keep candidates small. CV normalized RMSE 0.065 is low, indicating a well-fit surrogate, but with a tiny remaining budget I favor moderate exploitation over wide novelty search. Lowering exploration to 0.35 and radius to 0.15 tightens the search around promising regions while retaining some novelty for the 10-D space. auto still selects RBF vs quadratic by held-out RMSE; current_to_best balances convergence and diversity, and local_fraction 0.25 gives light intensification without wasting the scarce budget.
